name: MusicCueSheetEditor
tagline: Cue sheets with timings, splits and PRO submission – ready the moment you drop it in.
description: Complete Power Platform app for music coordinators: per-episode cue sheets with timecodes, usage types, writer and publisher splits validated to 100%, review/approval workflow and society (PRO) submission tracking, with dashboard, grid, timeline and board views.
features: Timecode parsing at 24/25/29.97/30 fps with live durations
Writer/publisher split editor with 100% validation and society per party
Status workflow with allowed transitions and per-status required data
Submit an episode's cue sheet in one step
Plain-text cue sheet and CSV export
Bulk status, owner and delete with undo
Drag & drop and keyboard status board
Demo mode with fictional sample cues
